# `deposits.term_deposit.DepositMatured`

The deposit matures and pays out: TotalPayout = Principal + NetInterest. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); no PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2).

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `principal_returned_cents` | `long` | PrincipalReturned as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents). |
| `net_interest_paid_cents` | `long` | NetInterestPaid as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents). |
| `total_payout_cents` | `long` | TotalPayout as integer EUR cents (Money.Cents). |
| `matured_on` | `int` (`date`) | MaturedOn (DateOnly) as days since epoch. |

## Governing ADRs

[ADR-IC-002](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md), [ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md)
